faq.h: Helio Sport iPad Photo Booth FAQs

items.q: What is the Helio Sport iPad Ringlight Photo Booth?
items.a: The Helio Sport is a portable iPad photo booth shell designed for professional events, photo booth businesses, weddings, parties and corporate activations. It features an aircraft-grade aluminum enclosure, a built-in halo ring light, a tiltable head and a stable aluminum base for a professional photo booth setup.

items.q: What is included with the Helio Sport Photo Booth?
items.a: The Helio Sport includes a tiltable head unit with halo ring light, two columns, one baseplate, an iPad charger, a power supply and a free one-month photo booth app subscription. It also includes a one-year manufacturer's warranty.

items.q: Which iPad sizes are compatible with the Helio Sport Photo Booth?
items.a: The Helio Sport supports several iPad sizes, including 9.7-inch, 10.2-inch, 10.5-inch, 10.9-inch and 11-inch iPad displays. Available product configurations include options for specific iPad generations, so select the size that matches your exact iPad model when ordering.

items.q: Does the Helio Sport Photo Booth include an iPad or battery pack?
items.a: No. The iPad and 12V battery pack are not included with the standard Helio Sport DIY shell. The booth does include an iPad charger and power supply, and it has a built-in battery compartment for adding a compatible battery pack.

items.q: Can the Helio Sport Photo Booth be used in portrait and landscape mode?
items.a: Yes. The Helio Sport can be configured for either portrait or landscape orientation. Its manual tilt feature also allows the head unit to be adjusted for different guest heights and event setups.
